title: Text Inside a Document Can Steer Your AI
description: Prompt injection tops the OWASP 2026 list of AI app risks. Treat document text as data, and ask who asked before any AI action.
ogDescription: Anything the AI reads is data. Only a person can give it a job. The who asked check.
alt: OWASP 2026 Top 10 list with LLM01 Prompt Injection first
ctaLine: Before any AI action, ask who actually asked for it.
author: Nick
